title: Russian Butter Spread
description: A classic Russian spread made with butter and velvety cream cheese.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese until smooth.
Add the butter and Russian spread to the bowl and beat until combined.
Add the sugar and vanilla extract to the bowl and mix well.
Beat the mixture until smooth and creamy.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the spread to a serving dish and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Serve chilled with crackers or bread.
